title: The greatest threat to your marriage isn't another person... it's neglect.
paragraphs: The greatest threat to your marriage isn't another person... it's neglect.
Most marriages don't fall apart overnight.
They slowly drift apart.
The conversations become shorter.
The laughter becomes quieter.
The affection becomes occasional.
The friendship becomes routine.
Before long, two people who once couldn't wait to be together begin living like roommates.
It doesn't have to stay that way.
God never intended marriage to merely survive.
He designed it to flourish.
This practical, Scripture-filled guide will help couples rediscover the joy, intimacy, friendship, and purpose that often get buried beneath busy schedules and daily responsibilities.
Whether you've been married for 5 years or 50 years, this book will encourage you to intentionally love your spouse again.
Inside You'll Discover:
❤️ How to reignite emotional and spiritual intimacy
❤️ Why romance is a daily choice—not just a feeling
❤️ Biblical principles for lasting communication
❤️ How forgiveness restores closeness
❤️ Practical ways to keep dating your spouse
❤️ Simple habits that strengthen your marriage year after year
❤️ How praying together can transform your relationship
❤️ How to love faithfully through every season of life
⚔️ Most people... vs. Few people...
Most people wait until their marriage is in crisis before seeking help.
Few people strengthen their marriage before problems grow.
Most people believe romance naturally fades.
Few people intentionally nurture love every day.
Most people settle for surviving.
Few people pursue the thriving marriage God desires.
Which one will you be?
✅ Exclusive biblical teachings and discipleship resources
🙏 Be the kind of believer who invests in your marriage before it's too late.
Don't just say your family matters.
Build it.
Strengthen it.
Protect it.
Honor God through the covenant He has entrusted to you.
💬 ENGAGE WITH THE COMMUNITY
Together, let's strengthen Christian marriages—one family at a time.
